records.title: CMT-DeepLab: Clustering Mask Transformers for Panoptic Segmentation
records.reason: This paper targets panoptic image segmentation with mask transformers and does not state an LLM inference or serving-efficiency contribution.

records.title: Augmenting Decompiler Output with Learned Variable Names and Types
records.reason: The work predicts variable names and types to improve decompiler output for reverse engineering; it is a software-analysis task, not LLM systems efficiency.

records.title: Visual-Locomotion: Learning to Walk on Complex Terrains with Vision
records.reason: This paper studies vision-based robot locomotion on complex terrain, without a stated language-model inference or serving method.

records.title: NoisyRollout: Reinforcing Visual Reasoning with Data Augmentation
records.reason: NoisyRollout augments visual inputs to improve VLM reasoning and test-time exploration; the abstract targets reasoning quality rather than lower inference cost.

records.title: Unlocking the Capabilities of Thought: A Reasoning Boundary Framework to Quantify and Optimize Chain-of-Thought
records.reason: The reasoning-boundary framework quantifies CoT capability and proposes strategies to improve reasoning outcomes; the abstract does not establish shorter sequences or reduced compute.

records.title: Reflected Diffusion Models
records.reason: Reflected Diffusion Models addresses numerical drift in score-based image generation; it is unrelated to LLM serving or inference efficiency.

records.title: Self-Routing Capsule Networks
records.reason: This paper introduces self-routing capsule networks, with no stated LLM inference, serving, or model-efficiency contribution.

records.title: Entropy-Preserving Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: Entropy-Preserving Reinforcement Learning studies exploration entropy in policy-gradient training; its contribution is a training objective rather than serving/runtime efficiency.

records.title: PyVision-RL: Forging Open Agentic Vision Models via RL
records.reason: PyVision-RL stabilizes RL training and interaction behavior for vision agents; it does not describe a lower-cost or faster inference implementation.

records.title: Vision-aligned Latent Reasoning for Multi-modal Large Language Model
records.reason: VaLR preserves visual information during multimodal reasoning with latent tokens and improves benchmark accuracy; the abstract reports no token, latency, or resource reduction.

records.title: Adaptive Information Control for Search-Augmented LLM Reasoning
records.reason: DeepControl regulates whether retrieval continues and how much evidence detail enters context, plausibly limiting redundant search and context overhead; the abstract reports effectiveness but no concrete retrieval-cost or latency reduction.

records.title: Abstracting Robot Manipulation Skills via Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Policies
records.reason: This paper targets robot manipulation policies with mixture-of-experts diffusion; its title states no LLM inference or serving-efficiency method.

records.title: WorldBench: Disambiguating Physics for Diagnostic Evaluation of World Models
records.reason: This is a diagnostic benchmark for world models and does not state a concrete LLM inference, serving, or runtime-efficiency contribution.

records.title: Learning to Decode in Parallel: Self-Coordinating Neural Network for Real-Time Quantum Error Correction
records.reason: The work improves parallel neural decoders for real-time quantum error correction, including high throughput on TPU; it targets quantum decoding, not LLM execution.

records.title: Agent Contracts: A Formal Framework for Resource-Bounded Autonomous AI Systems
records.reason: Agent Contracts formally bound multi-agent resource and time consumption and report a 90% token reduction in iterative workflows, directly addressing resource-bounded AI execution.

records.title: Evolution of root nodule symbiosis via paleopolyploidy and modular pathway rewiring.
records.reason: This paper studies the evolution of root-nodule symbiosis, outside LLM inference, serving, or model-efficiency scope.

records.title: Mitigating LLM Hallucination via Behaviorally Calibrated Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: Behaviorally calibrated RL changes model training to reduce hallucination; the abstract focuses on factuality and does not claim inference-efficiency improvements.

records.title: MACE-Dance: Motion-Appearance Cascaded Experts for Music-Driven Dance Video Generation
records.reason: This paper targets music-driven dance video generation and does not state an LLM inference, serving, runtime, or efficiency contribution.

records.title: Mitigating the Safety Alignment Tax with Null-Space Constrained Policy Optimization
records.reason: Null-space constrained policy optimization mitigates capability loss during safety alignment training; it is a training method, not an inference/runtime optimization.

records.title: ReCAD: Reinforcement Learning Enhanced Parametric CAD Model Generation with Vision-Language Models
records.reason: ReCAD applies vision-language models and RL to parametric CAD generation; it is a design-generation application without an LLM-system efficiency contribution.
